policy: Only derived mesh copies are welded and collapsed. Original shape, UV atlas, generated PBR, 63-bone rig and Run/Head actions remain the source. Face, mouth, eye-bearing front head and complete wrist-influenced hand surfaces are protected; all arms receive soft priority. Every source vertex and every derived triangle centre/edge midpoint are checked bidirectionally. No voxel remesh, replacement geometry or new atlas. Original sources and Assets are never overwritten.
